erin: quick ping — seabreeze15b (int4) canary popped a couple CUDA OOMs and lots of small-slot churn on 1.5k+ token chats. saw 5xx spike briefly. anyone free to triage? :wave:

	hamid: paste a log excerpt?

	erin:```
	2026-03-25T14:05:12Z worker-7 ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory	alloc_chunk=1.1MB	free_slots=1	max_new_tokens=1024	microbatch=6	prefetch=on	quant=int4
	```

	jules: fragmentation signature. int4 reduces model bytes but increases number of per-token temp allocations. two low-risk levers: lower default max_new_tokens 1024->384 and microbatch.soft_cap 6->3 for seabreeze15b-int4. also try kv_trim_margin=0.55 (was 0.75).

	tara: also observed a small quality regression on long-summary tests after int4: ROUGE-L down ~1.4 vs fp16 when max_new_tokens high. running a sweep now: `./evals/run_quality.py --model seabreeze15b --quant int4 --suite long-summ --out ./out/1739995555`

	infra-bot: canary deploy record: seabreeze15b-int4 v2026.03.25.14 deployed to pool-canary-1 (sha: f9e8d7).

	hamid: operational suggestion: don't revert quant yet. route chat endpoints with context_estimate >1200 to seabreeze15b-int8. That gives users long-chat correctness and avoids capacity churn.

	erin: plan: (1) jules to roll config patch to canary with max_new_tokens=384, microbatch_cap=3, kv_trim_margin=0.55 and enable slab_coalesce=experimental on one worker (ETA 45m), (2) tara to finish eval sweep and post diffs (ETA 2h), (3) hamid to add routing rule for long contexts to int8 and test (ETA 1h). If eval delta >2pt we'll keep long-chat routing to int8.

	jules: patching now. I'll run quick smoke with `python tools/smoke.py --model seabreeze15b --quant int4 --batch 4 --max_new_tokens 384` and report memory histograms after 20m.

	tara: sweep kicked off, writing outputs to gs://redwood-evals/seabreeze15b/1739995555/; will include sample mismatches.

	infra-bot: smoke check: canary worker with slab_coalesce=on saw reduced free_slot variance and no OOMs in 25m. control worker still shows spikes.

	erin: nice. keep monitoring and post the eval summary when ready. if anyone sees >1% 5xx for 10m, page SRE. thanks team :thumbsup:
